theorems.statement: ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (F : E → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 F → ∀ x₀ : E, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x : E, ‖x - x₀‖ ≤ ε → ∀ Q Q' : E, |fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x Q Q' - fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x₀ Q Q'| ≤ δ * (‖Q‖ * ‖Q'‖)
